items.title: Google Pixel 11 搭載 Gemini Intelligence：主動通知、語境搜尋全面上線
items.title_en: Google Pixel 11 debuts Gemini Intelligence with proactive AI notifications and real-time Circle to Search
items.summary: Google 8 月 12 日發布 Pixel 11 系列，新增 Gemini Automation（語音控制 app 導航）、主動式 AI 通知、即時 Circle to Search 整合；Tensor G6 晶片支援全機種端側 AI 運算，Magic Capture 自動捕捉最佳瞬間。
items.summary_en: Google unveiled Pixel 11 on Aug 12 with Gemini Automation for voice-controlled app navigation, proactive AI notifications, real-time Circle to Search, and Tensor G6-powered on-device AI across the entire lineup.
items.why: 裝置端 AI 走向主動助理，預示行動廣告互動模式將變
items.why_en: On-device AI is shifting from reactive to proactive — sets the stage for new mobile ad interaction patterns.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: OpenAI 系 Thrive Holdings 完成 20 億美元融資，派駐員工落場做企業 AI 整合
items.title_en: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings raises $2B to embed AI directly into traditional businesses
items.summary: Thrive Holdings 以 120 億美元估值完成 20 億融資，由軟銀、D1 Capital Partners 及 Altimeter 領投；商業模式係收購傳統企業，派駐 OpenAI 員工落場加速 AI 整合，OpenAI 本身持股並深度介入營運。
items.summary_en: Thrive Holdings raised $2B at a $12B valuation from SoftBank, D1, and Altimeter; it acquires traditional businesses and deploys OpenAI employees on-site to accelerate AI adoption, with OpenAI holding an equity stake.
items.why: AI 整合入傳統行業加速，客戶數字轉型節奏快過預期
items.why_en: AI integration into traditional industries is accelerating — client digital transformation timelines will compress faster than expected.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Meta 開源 30B 模型 Muse Glimmer：筆電直跑、Apache 2.0 免費用
items.title_en: Meta open-sources Muse Glimmer — a 30B agentic model that runs on a single laptop under Apache 2.0
items.summary: Meta 於 8 月 10 日正式發布 Muse Glimmer，即旗艦模型 Muse Spark 1.2 嘅開源版本；30 億參數，Apache 2.0 授權，支援文字、程式碼及圖片生成，可在單一消費級 GPU 或筆電運行，已上 Hugging Face 免費下載。
items.summary_en: Meta released Muse Glimmer on Aug 10 — an Apache 2.0, 30B open-source version of its flagship Muse Spark 1.2 model — capable of text, code, and image generation on a single consumer GPU or laptop, now on Hugging Face.
items.why: 創意團隊可本地跑 AI 免費測試，開源生態推動工具成本再降
items.why_en: Creative teams can now run a powerful agentic AI locally at zero cost — open-source momentum will drive tool costs down further.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Google Ads 推出 Gemini AI 報告 Dashboard，自然語言即查投放表現
items.title_en: Google Ads launches Gemini AI dashboards with natural-language campaign performance queries and Ask Advisor agent
items.summary: Google 為 Google Ads 同 Analytics 推出 AI 報告 Dashboard，廣告主可直接用口語問問題即時生成可視化報告；新增 Ask Advisor AI 代理串連 Ads、Analytics、Merchant Center 同 GMP，支援跨平台即時診斷同行業 benchmark 比較。
items.summary_en: Google launched Gemini AI dashboards across Ads and Analytics, letting advertisers query performance data in plain language and generate visual reports instantly; the Ask Advisor agent cross-references Ads, Analytics, Merchant Center, and GMP for real-time benchmarking.
items.why: 出報告唔再靠手動 export，慳走數小時重複工序
items.why_en: Campaign reporting no longer requires manual exports — natural-language queries eliminate hours of repetitive data work.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Spotify 9 月推「AI Persona」標籤：AI 生成藝人帳號預設排除推薦
items.title_en: Spotify rolls out 'AI Persona' badges in September to label AI-generated artists, excluding them from algorithmic recommendations by default
items.summary: Spotify 9 月中推出 AI Persona 徽章，標示可能 AI 生成的藝人帳號；被標記帳號預設排除出推薦，屬平台 2026 年透明化策略一部分。
items.summary_en: Spotify's 'AI Persona' badge (rolling out mid-September) flags profiles where the artist identity may be AI-generated, excluding them from editorial and algorithmic recommendations by default as part of the platform's 2026 transparency push.
items.why: 音樂 KOL 合作多咗 AI 身份真偽風險，due diligence 要加一步
items.why_en: Music creator partnerships now carry AI identity risk — brand due diligence needs an extra verification step.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Google Maps「Ask Maps」上線新加坡及全球 160 個國家，對話式本地搜尋大改版
items.title_en: Google Maps launches Gemini-powered 'Ask Maps' in Singapore and 160+ markets — the platform's biggest transformation in a decade
items.summary: Google 在新加坡及全球超 160 個市場推出 Ask Maps，用戶可用自然語言搜尋本地商家、路線同酒店報價，內建實時交通更新；Google 形容此為地圖平台十年最大變革。
items.summary_en: Google's Ask Maps (Gemini-powered conversational local search) expanded to 160+ countries including Singapore on Aug 12, enabling natural-language discovery with real-time transit and hotel pricing — described as Google Maps' biggest transformation in over a decade.
items.why: 本地 SEO 邏輯將轉向 AI 推薦，品牌 Google 商家資料完整度更影響曝光
items.why_en: Local SEO logic is shifting to AI-driven recommendations — complete, accurate Google Business data will directly affect brand visibility in Ask Maps.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Runway API 新增 xAI Grok Imagine Image 2：支援圖片編輯模式、最高 2K 輸出
items.title_en: Runway API adds xAI's Grok Imagine Image 2 with direct image edit mode and 2K output — live now
items.summary: Runway 開發者 API 於 8 月 11 日新增 Grok Imagine Image 2，支援文字生圖、圖片直接編輯模式，最高 2K 解析度輸出；低質量 4 credits、高質量 8 credits，品牌可直接調用做廣告圖素生成及快速修改。
items.summary_en: Runway's API added xAI's Grok Imagine Image 2 on Aug 11, supporting text-to-image and a direct image edit mode with 1K/2K output at 4–8 credits per image — ready for brand asset generation and iteration now.
items.why: 圖片編輯模式可直接改現有素材，省去重新生成的時間同 credits
items.why_en: Edit mode lets you modify existing images without regenerating from scratch — cuts iteration time and credit cost for ad creative.

items.title: Runway API 同日加入 Seedance 2.5 同 Grok Imagine Video 1.5：兩款新影片生成模型開放開發者
items.title_en: Runway API adds Seedance 2.5 and Grok Imagine Video 1.5 — two new AI video models open to developers
items.summary: Runway API 同日新增 ByteDance Seedance 2.5（最長 30 秒、50 個多模態參考、720p）同 xAI Grok Imagine Video 1.5（最長 15 秒、原生音頻、1080p），兩款模型即日可調用，適合品牌做不同長度廣告影片素材。
items.summary_en: Runway's API added ByteDance Seedance 2.5 (up to 30-sec, 50 multimodal references, 720p) and xAI Grok Imagine Video 1.5 (up to 15-sec, native audio, 1080p) on Aug 7 — both now accessible to developers for brand video production.
items.why: 兩款模型互補，短片 + 長片廣告素材可用同一 API 流程批量生成
items.why_en: Two complementary models cover short and long video needs — batch-generate campaign assets of different lengths within a single API pipeline.

items.title: ByteDance Dreamina 推 Seedance 2.5：30 秒生成、50 個多模態參考輸入、時間戳編輯
items.title_en: ByteDance's Dreamina launches Seedance 2.5 with 30-sec generation, 50 multimodal references, and timestamp-level editing
items.summary: Dreamina 發布 Seedance 2.5，單次最長生成 30 秒，長片模式達 3 分鐘；支援最多 50 個多模態參考輸入，時間戳編輯令品牌可做多版本廣告片，減少拼接問題。
items.summary_en: Dreamina launched Seedance 2.5 with up to 30-second generation per clip (3-minute Long Video Mode), 50 multimodal reference inputs, and timestamp editing — directly addressing fragmented multi-version brand video production workflows.
items.why: 50 個參考輸入令品牌視覺一致性大幅提升，同一 brief 可批量出多版廣告片
items.why_en: 50-reference support solves brand visual consistency at scale — one brief can generate multiple campaign video variants without visual drift.

items.title: WPP 行政總裁 Cindy Rose 將員工花紅池翻倍至 1.3 億英鎊，推 Elevate28 整合戰略
items.title_en: WPP CEO Cindy Rose more than doubles staff bonus pool to £130M, linking half to group-wide performance under Elevate28
items.summary: WPP CEO Cindy Rose 將 2026 年上半年激勵池提升 120% 至 1.3 億英鎊；花紅改為一半與全集團業績掛鈎，屬 Elevate28 整合策略一部分。
items.summary_en: WPP CEO Cindy Rose expanded the H1 2026 incentive pool 120% YoY to £130M, restructuring bonuses so half of each employee's payout depends on group-wide WPP performance — using pay structure to drive cross-agency integration under Elevate28.
items.why: WPP 整合深化影響其旗下 agency 服務模式，全方位 agency 關係評估要重新考量
items.why_en: WPP's integration push will reshape how its agencies go to market — worth reassessing the value of consolidated vs. specialist agency relationships.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Burson 收購 AI 公司 Limbik，Campaign 發布前可預測訊息傳播力及可信度
items.title_en: PR firm Burson acquires Limbik to forecast message virality and believability before launch, rolling out across 60+ markets
items.summary: Burson 收購認知 AI 公司 Limbik，技術能在品牌訊息發布前預測傳播力及可信度；收購後整合入全球超 60 個市場服務流程，令客戶可在落廣告前先測試訊息。
items.summary_en: Burson acquired Limbik, a cognitive AI firm that forecasts message virality and believability before launch, and is integrating the tech across 60+ markets to give clients pre-launch testing of whether communications will resonate and spread.
items.why: Campaign 前測 AI 技術進主流，能否預判訊息口碑將成 agency 競爭優勢
items.why_en: AI-powered pre-launch message testing is entering the mainstream — virality forecasting will become a key agency differentiator in pitches.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: 抖音收緊 AI 仿真人短劇規管，8 月起四類題材過審率跌至 30% 以下
items.title_en: Douyin tightens AI virtual-character short drama rules across four content categories — approval rate drops below 30% from August 3
items.summary: 抖音短劇版權中心宣布，8 月 3 日起四類 AI 仿真人短劇須符合更嚴製作規範；新規後全網下架逾 7 萬部違規短劇，新劇過審率跌至 30% 以下。
items.summary_en: Douyin's short drama copyright centre announced stricter production rules for AI virtual-character dramas across four content categories from August 3; over 70,000 non-compliant videos were removed and the approval rate dropped below 30%, raising compliance risk for brand integrations.
items.why: 抖音 AI 短劇規管趨嚴，品牌植入合規評估要跟上，否則素材隨時被下架
items.why_en: Tighter Douyin AI drama rules mean brand integrations face higher takedown risk — compliance assessment must be built into any AI short-drama brief.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: TikTok Symphony Agent 正式推出：AI 將 brief 直轉廣告素材，MCP 伺服器支援 Claude/ChatGPT 直接落廣告
items.title_en: TikTok Symphony Agent goes live: AI turns brand briefs into TikTok ads using live trend data, with MCP server for Claude/ChatGPT ad management
items.summary: TikTok Q3 2026 官方產品預覽確認 Symphony Agent 上線，可將品牌 brief 結合平台即時趨勢資料生成廣告素材；新增 Agentic Hub 配備 MCP 伺服器，令 Claude 或 ChatGPT 可直接管理廣告戶口；升級版 Symphony Avatar 可大量生成 UGC 風格短片。
items.summary_en: TikTok's Q3 2026 product preview confirms Symphony Agent is live, turning brand briefs into TikTok-ready ads using real-time trend data; a new Agentic Hub with an MCP server lets Claude or ChatGPT directly manage TikTok ad accounts, while upgraded avatars enable UGC-style video at scale.
items.why: Agency 可用 AI agent 直管 TikTok 廣告戶口，減走重複操作，是新 pitch 服務點
items.why_en: Agencies can pilot AI-managed TikTok campaigns via MCP — reduces manual ops and opens a new AI-driven service offering to pitch clients.

items.title: Google Ads Ask Advisor 跨平台 AI 問答：三個問題即上手
items.title_en: 3 questions to get started with Google Ads Ask Advisor — cross-platform AI campaign diagnosis in plain language
items.summary: Google Ads 新嘅 Ask Advisor AI 代理可同時讀取 Ads、Analytics、Merchant Center 同 GMP 數據；三個立即可試嘅問題範本：「上月 CPA 最低受眾係邊個？」「哪個廣告組轉化率跌最多？」「同行業 benchmark 相比我嘅 CTR 如何？」——唔使識 SQL 即刻用得。
items.summary_en: Google Ads' Ask Advisor can simultaneously query Ads, Analytics, Merchant Center, and GMP data. Three starter queries to try now: 'Which audience had the lowest CPA last month?' / 'Which ad group saw the biggest conversion rate drop?' / 'How does my CTR compare to industry benchmarks?' — no SQL needed.
items.why: 非技術同事可自助分析，唔再依賴 data analyst 出每一份報告
items.why_en: Non-technical team members can self-serve campaign analysis — reduces the dependency on a data analyst for every performance report.

items.title: 本地 Search 做好一件事：補齊 Google 商家資料，搶 Ask Maps AI 推薦位
items.title_en: One quick win for local search: complete your Google Business Profile now to capture Ask Maps AI recommendations
items.summary: Ask Maps 全球鋪開後，Gemini 推薦本地商家取決於 Google Business Profile 完整度；重點欄位：業務時間、服務標籤、最新相片、評論回覆，而家補好係最低成本 SEO 動作。
items.summary_en: With Ask Maps rolling out globally, Gemini's local recommendations are driven by Google Business Profile completeness. Key fields: updated hours, service tags, recent photos, and replied reviews. Each gap directly reduces AI recommendation probability — filling them now is the lowest-cost SEO action available.
items.why: Ask Maps 推薦位唔靠廣告費、靠資料完整度，即刻補即刻受惠
items.why_en: Ask Maps recommendations aren't bought with ad spend — they're earned through data completeness. Fix it now and benefit immediately.
